_readme:
llm-gateway 供应商预设目录（供 scripts/presets.mjs 使用）。

来源：mu-zi-lee/magpie-our-free-model（MIT）的 vendor/ofm/src/providers/registry.json，
逐条归一化到本项目的 provider 形状。**不含任何密钥** —— 只记录 apiKeyEnv（变量名提示）。

字段说明：
  freeTier   —— 上游标注的免费档/免费额度（9router/FCC 的说法），仅供参考，不保证长期有效
  manualOnly —— 无法用「baseURL + apiKey」表达（oauth / adc / 本地服务），需手工配置
  apiKeyEnv  —— 建议的环境变量名，CLI 添加时会提示你填入对应 Key

presets.name: Agnes AI
presets.notes: Reasoning arrives as think tags on this route (FCC profile).

presets.name: Alibaba Cloud
presets.notes: DashScope international compatible-mode endpoint (9router alims-intl, same base URL as FCC).

presets.name: Anthropic
presets.notes: Native Anthropic Messages passthrough (FCC marks it native_messages_passthrough).

presets.name: Baidu Qianfan
presets.notes: Baidu Qianfan v2 OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

presets.name: BazaarLink
presets.notes: Multi-vendor gateway with an auto:free slug; 9router lists it as free-tier.

presets.name: Amazon Bedrock
presets.notes: Bedrock Mantle OpenAI-compatible endpoint; the base URL stays configurable because keys and model availability are region-scoped (FCC).

presets.name: BytePlus Ark
presets.notes: Free credits for new accounts (9router notice); Seed 2.0, Kimi K2 Thinking, GLM 4.7 and GPT-OSS-120B.

presets.name: Cerebras
presets.notes: max_tokens is sent as max_completion_tokens (FCC profile).

presets.name: Cheaper Inference
presets.notes: Listing is filtered to streaming text models (FCC profile).

presets.name: Chutes
presets.notes: FCC lists only text-in/text-out models that advertise tool support.

presets.name: ClinePass
presets.notes: ClinePass subscription key; FCC lists it from /ai/cline/recommended-models.

presets.name: Cloudflare
presets.notes: Account-scoped URL — replace {account_id}; Workers AI has a free allocation and 9router lists it as free-tier. Image ids omitted.

presets.name: Cohere
presets.notes: Compatibility layer at /compatibility/v1; several body keys are stripped (FCC profile).

presets.name: DeepInfra
presets.notes: FCC reads DeepInfra’s own /models/list shape (model_name / reported_type).

presets.name: DeepSeek
presets.notes: Cache usage is reported on this endpoint (FCC).

presets.name: Experiential Labs
presets.notes: Experiential Labs gateway.

presets.name: Featherless AI
presets.notes: FCC asks for tool_use + available_on_current_plan rows; pagination is numbered.

presets.name: Fireworks
presets.notes: Embedding id omitted; model ids are account-scoped paths.

presets.name: Gemini
presets.notes: Google AI Studio key; 9router lists it as free-tier. FCC speaks the OpenAI-compatible layer at /v1beta/openai/.

presets.name: GitHub Copilot
presets.notes: GitHub account sign-in; the usable model set depends on the subscription (embedding ids omitted).

presets.name: Z.ai (Anthropic wire)
presets.notes: Z.ai Anthropic-compatible route (Claude Code style); the same ZAI_API_KEY as the zai/zai_api records. Key URL as declared in the 9router glm registry.

presets.name: Zhipu GLM (CN)
presets.notes: Zhipu open-platform coding endpoint (mainland China), distinct from the z.ai international records.

presets.name: Groq
presets.notes: OpenAI-compatible endpoint; audio ids from the same registry listing are omitted (chat catalog).

presets.name: Hugging Face
presets.notes: Inference Providers router; FCC resolves the context window from the live provider consensus.

presets.name: Hyperbolic AI
presets.notes: OpenAI-compatible chat completions; 9router registry declares the key URL.

presets.name: Kilo.ai
presets.notes: Kilo gateway free pool; the plugin’s own Kilo channel reads the same host.

presets.name: Kimchi
presets.notes: 9router lists it as free-tier with oauth and apikey modes; the signup URL issues the credential. The user-agent is declared by the 9router registry.

presets.name: Kimi
presets.notes: Moonshot platform key; caller extra_body is rejected on this route (FCC profile).

presets.name: Kimi Code
presets.notes: Kimi Code subscription; ids from the 9router kimi registry (same host, api.kimi.com/coding/v1).

presets.name: Lightning AI
presets.notes: Lightning AI Model APIs gateway.

presets.name: LLaMA.cpp
presets.notes: Local server; the model list is whatever the user has loaded, so the registry carries no ids.

presets.name: LLM7.io
presets.notes: FCC also pins the default/fast/pro aliases; the listing is filtered to streaming tool models.

presets.name: LM Studio
presets.notes: Local server; the model list is whatever the user has loaded, so the registry carries no ids.

presets.name: MiniMax
presets.notes: Reasoning is split out of the text stream (FCC profile); speech/image ids omitted.

presets.name: MiniMax (CN)
presets.notes: MiniMax mainland endpoint speaking the Anthropic Messages wire; speech ids omitted. The anthropic-beta header is declared by the 9router registry.

presets.name: Mistral
presets.notes: La Plateforme keys; embedding id omitted.

presets.name: Mistral Codestral
presets.notes: Codestral IDE endpoint, distinct from La Plateforme keys (FCC).

presets.name: Morph LLM
presets.notes: Fast apply/edit models for coding agents.

presets.name: NaraRoute
presets.notes: Multi-vendor gateway; reasoning is surfaced as a boolean in the listing (FCC profile).

presets.name: Nebius Token Factory
presets.notes: Embedding id omitted; FCC requires architecture.modality=text->text in the listing.

presets.name: Novita AI
presets.notes: FCC README example id.

presets.name: NVIDIA NIM
presets.notes: Free access for NVIDIA Developer Program members (prototyping and testing) per the 9router registry; FCC ships it as the default provider.

presets.name: Ollama
presets.notes: Local server; FCC normalizes the configured root to /v1, and the model list is whatever the user has pulled.

presets.name: Ollama Cloud
presets.notes: Free tier: light usage, one cloud model at a time (9router notice). Tags are not OpenAI ids but Ollama model names.

presets.name: OpenRouter
presets.notes: Free tier: 27+ free models, no credit card, ~200 requests/day (9router registry).

presets.name: OpenAI / ChatGPT
presets.notes: ChatGPT subscription via browser sign-in (connected account); responses wire on chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex.

presets.name: OpenAI API
presets.notes: Platform API key; FCC drives this route over the Responses API. Non-chat ids (embeddings, speech, images) are omitted.

presets.name: OpenCode Free
presets.notes: Keyless free pool (noAuth) — the plugin’s own free lane speaks to the same /zen/v1 host and sends the same x-opencode-client header. Per-model wires differ: two models answer over /responses and union-alpha over the Anthropic wire (9router

presets.name: OpenCode Zen

presets.name: Opper
presets.notes: Opper gateway (v3/compat base).

presets.name: OrcaRouter
presets.notes: Multi-provider gateway with a free slug.

presets.name: Perplexity
presets.notes: Search-augmented Sonar chat models.

presets.name: Poolside AI
presets.notes: Poolside platform key.

presets.name: QwenCloud Token Plan
presets.notes: QwenCloud Token Plan endpoint (9router alitp-intl, same base URL as FCC).

presets.name: QwenCloud Coding Plan

presets.name: Scaleway

presets.name: SiliconFlow
presets.notes: Chat ids from the 9router registry; listing is filtered with sub_type=chat.

presets.name: Tencent Hunyuan

presets.name: Together AI

presets.name: TokenRouter

presets.name: Vercel AI Gateway

presets.notes: ADC (no key): VERTEX_PROJECT_ID and VERTEX_LOCATION compose the endpoint (FCC providers/vertex/endpoint.py).

presets.name: Vertex Partner Models
presets.notes: Vertex MaaS partner models (9router model list); the OpenAI-compatible base is composed per project/location (FCC providers/vertex/endpoint.py).

presets.name: Volcengine Ark

presets.name: Wafer

presets.name: W&B Inference

presets.name: xAI (Grok)

presets.notes: Token Plan subscription (keys start with tp-) and are cluster-specific; TTS ids omitted (9router notice).

presets.name: xKiro

presets.name: Z.ai API

presets.notes: max_tokens is sent as max_completion_tokens (FCC profile).
